name: Frontier Transport Holdings Limited
summary: Frontier Transport Holdings Limited, an investment holding company, operates in the transport sector in South Africa. It operates in two segments, Passenger transport services and Vehicle and spares  sales and servicing. The company operates diesel buses, electric buses and luxury charter coaches. It also provides public transport, school and private tours, luxury coaches, shuttle services, as well as involved in parts and spares sales. The company was formerly known as Hosken Passenger Logistics and Rail Limited and changed its name to Frontier Transport Holdings Limited in September 2021. Frontier Transport Holdings Limited was founded in 1861 and is based in Cape Town, South Africa. Frontier Transport Holdings Limited is a subsidiary of Hosken Consolidated Investments Limited.
